# Applied Biostatistics with R

This course introduces practical biostatistical methods using R, with a focus on clinical and health data analysis.

## Target Audience

Clinicians, biomedical researchers, PhD students, public health professionals, and analysts who need a practical foundation in statistical analysis with R.

## Practical Information

| Item | Information |
|---|---|
| Format | Online |
| Schedule | Monday, Wednesday, Friday |
| Time | 17:00-19:00 Morocco time |
| Price | 1500 DH |
| Seats | 20 participants maximum |
| Registration | Opens 10 days before course start |

## Learning Objectives

By the end of this course, participants will be able to:

- import, clean, and summarize health datasets in R;
- choose appropriate statistical tests;
- fit and interpret regression models;
- produce reproducible tables and figures;
- prepare analysis outputs for reports and manuscripts.
